extraMeanings.en: to become or make something more serious or intense
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The conflict quickly escalated into a full-scale war.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çatışma hızla tam ölçekli bir savaşa dönüştü.

extraMeanings.en: to increase in amount or level
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Housing costs have escalated over the past decade.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Konut maliyetleri son on yılda hızla arttı.

extraMeanings.en: to respect and admire someone or something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She is highly esteemed by her colleagues.

extraMeanings.en: to avoid answering a question directly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The minister evaded the question about tax increases.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bakan vergi artışlarıyla ilgili soruyu geçiştirdi.

extraMeanings.en: to avoid paying money that you should pay
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He was accused of evading taxes for years.

extraMeanings.en: showing or describing sex or violence in a very detailed way
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The film contains sexually explicit scenes.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Film cinsel açıdan müstehcen sahneler içeriyor.

extraMeanings.en: the process of making or building something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The fabrication of the steel beams took several weeks.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çelik kirişlerin imalatı birkaç hafta sürdü.

extraMeanings.exampleEn: The orchestra played the final chords forte.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Orkestra son akorları forte, yani yüksek sesle çaldı.

extraMeanings.en: to add vitamins or minerals to food or drink
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The cereal is fortified with iron and vitamins.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu tahıl gevreği demir ve vitaminlerle takviye edilmiştir.

extraMeanings.en: to make someone feel stronger or more determined
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She fortified herself with a cup of coffee before the meeting.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Toplantıdan önce bir fincan kahveyle kendini güçlendirdi.

extraMeanings.en: the right to vote in elections
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Women were granted the franchise in the early twentieth century.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kadınlara yirminci yüzyılın başında oy hakkı tanındı.

extraMeanings.en: to clench your teeth, often to show determination
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She gritted her teeth and kept climbing.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Dişlerini sıktı ve tırmanmaya devam etti.

extraMeanings.en: a row of bushes forming a boundary
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A tall hedge separated the two gardens.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yüksek bir çit iki bahçeyi birbirinden ayırıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to avoid giving a direct answer or commitment
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He hedged when asked about his future plans.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Gelecek planları sorulduğunda kaçamak cevap verdi.

extraMeanings.en: to cast a spell on someone to bring bad luck
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The old woman was said to have hexed the whole village.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı kadının tüm köye büyü yaptığı söyleniyordu.

extraMeanings.exampleEn: A hind and her fawn grazed at the edge of the forest.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bir dişi geyik ve yavrusu ormanın kenarında otluyordu.

extraMeanings.en: a store of valuable things that has been hidden away
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Archaeologists discovered a hoard of ancient gold coins.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Arkeologlar antik altın sikkelerden oluşan bir define buldu.
